insights.finding: Food logged by noon: 650 kcal and 40 g protein, against a 113-156 g protein target. Your bulk pace is already at the low edge.

week.headline: Cardio and HRV improved, but late bedtimes and zero lifting stall your lean bulk.

insights.finding: Bedtimes were 00:40-01:03 on Fri, Sun, Mon and Tue nights, against your 23:30 goal. Sleep averaged 7.1h (8.0h prior week) and debt reached 4h41. Your recovery drops 16 points when you're asleep after 1:00.
insights.action: Drop the 00:45 experiment (0/8 nights on target). Lights out by 23:30 Sunday to Thursday next week.

insights.finding: Lifting was 0 min this week (6.4 min/day the week before). Your last split was arms on Wed Sep 30, so the lean bulk has no training stimulus.
insights.action: Lift Thu to Sun at 17:30 in queue order: chest/tri, back/bi, legs/abs, arms. Then keep 4 fixed gym days next week.

insights.finding: Weight went from 70.0 to 70.9 kg since Aug 27, about 0.15 kg/week. That is below your 0.25 goal and under the 0.18-0.35 target range.
insights.action: Add about 250 kcal a day starting tomorrow, such as a shake with milk and oats at 16:00. Re-weigh on Thursday Oct 22.

insights.finding: Cardio held up: cardio on Fri, 90 min soccer on Sat (strain 15.9), 8 km run on Mon. HRV averaged 83.1 vs 76.9 and recovery 74.8 vs 70.3. No knee impact spike.

insights.finding: Steps averaged 6,738, down from 10,929. Tue had 4,015 and Wed 4,302. Sat had no data and today looks partially synced.
insights.action: Take a 30 min walk at lunch on non-lifting days to get back to 10,000 steps.

today.headline: Poor sleep and 58% recovery: go easy, sleep early, and fuel up.

insights.finding: You slept 5h54 last night (score 65, consistency 48) after a 23:52 bedtime. Sleep debt is 4h41 and recovery is 58%, below your 65% baseline. Sleep is the main drag.
insights.action: Be asleep by 22:20 tonight to work toward your 10h10 need, waking at 08:30.

insights.finding: Load ratio is 1.60 (high) and you are 0/4 in the gym with four days left. Chest/tri is fresh at 100%, and no impact spike is flagged.
insights.action: Lift chest/tri this evening at moderate effort, strain 10 to 14, about 60 minutes. No jumps or sprints.

insights.finding: You have 900 steps by noon against a 10,000 goal, with 577 sedentary minutes so far. Movement has to be planned today.
insights.action: Walk 20 minutes now and another 20 before 18:00, aiming for about 5,000 steps today.

insights.finding: Protein is 40g against a 113 to 156g target, with 650 calories logged by noon. Protein is short for the day so far.
insights.action: Eat 70 to 100g of protein across your next two meals, such as chicken, eggs, Greek yogurt, or a shake.

week.headline: Late bedtimes and skipped lifting drove a sleep-debt week, though recovery averaged higher.

insights.finding: Bedtimes drifted to 00:40 to 01:03 from Saturday to Wednesday, against your 23:30 goal. Your personal pattern shows asleep-by-1:00 nights cut next-morning recovery by about 16 points.
insights.action: Lights out by 23:30 on at least five nights next week. Friday's 22:43 bedtime gave your best recovery, 92%.

insights.finding: Recovery averaged 74.8% (up from 70.3%) and HRV averaged 83.1 ms (up from 76.9), even as sleep slipped. Your body is absorbing load well.
insights.action: Schedule your hardest sessions after nights with 7h or more of sleep, and check recovery before each one.

insights.finding: You logged zero gym sessions and zero lifting minutes this week, against 6.4 last week. Instead you did a 90-minute soccer match (strain 15.9) and an 8 km run, both impact work that aggravates your knee.
insights.action: Lift four sessions next week, chest/tri first. Swap runs and soccer for lifting or cycling. No sprints or jumps.

insights.finding: Steps averaged 6,738 against 10,929 last week, and active calories fell to 337 from 547. Tuesday and Wednesday had only 4,015 and 4,302 steps.
insights.action: Walk at least 8,000 steps daily next week, with a 30-minute walk on each rest day.

insights.finding: Weight rose from 70.0 to 70.9 kg between Aug 27 and Oct 8, but the trend is -0.10 kg/wk, below your 0.18 to 0.35 kg/wk lean-bulk pace.
insights.action: Add about 300 kcal a day, mainly carbohydrates around training, then check the weekly trend in two weeks.
